overview.title: Overview
overview.text: In today's digital landscape, AI-generated content has become increasingly prevalent. However, this content often lacks the subtle nuances and imperfections that make human-created work feel authentic. DetectiFy bridges this gap by intelligently processing your AI-generated content to add those natural, human-like qualities.

about.title: About Us
paragraphs: We are a team of AI researchers, developers, and creative professionals passionate about bridging the gap between artificial and human intelligence. Our mission is to make AI-generated content more accessible and authentic by adding the subtle human touches that make content truly engaging.

Founded in 2025, DetectiFy has quickly become the go-to solution for content creators, marketers, and businesses looking to enhance their AI-generated assets. We believe the future of content creation lies not in replacing humans with AI, but in blending AI efficiency with human creativity.
